metaTitle: For Creators | Brand Deals and Growth Support | Noise Culture
metaDescription: Apply to join Noise Culture: long-term brand deals, growth support, production help, sponsored creator trips and brand building for creators.

hero.h1: Your talent. Our network. Bigger possibilities.
hero.text: We help creators build lasting careers: steady brand deals, a full production team when you need one, group trips with other creators and, where it fits, a brand of your own.

benefits.title: Brand deals that last
benefits.text: We bring you brand partnerships that fit your audience and build long-term relationships, not one-off posts. You are free to accept or decline any brand.

benefits.title: Help growing your channel
benefits.text: We plan your growth with you: content direction, platform strategy, collaborations and regular reviews of what is working.

benefits.title: Support from idea to upload
benefits.text: Content ideation, scripting and script writers, editors, and a personal manager when you need one. We can also help with equipment. We work out the details with you in a personal meeting.

benefits.title: Sponsored creator trips
benefits.text: We organise sponsored trips where creators come together to create content and collaborate, with brand projects arranged for the trip. We share the details in a personal meeting.

benefits.title: Build a brand with us
benefits.text: If you want a brand of your own, we are open to building and growing it with you, from first idea to launch. Terms are agreed case by case.

benefits.title: Supporting cast, found for you
benefits.text: Is your content bigger than one person? We help you find the people for the side roles in your shows and videos, so you can lead.

alsoWithUs.title: Written contracts
alsoWithUs.text: Every deal is written down before work starts.

alsoWithUs.title: Free to say no
alsoWithUs.text: You can decline any brand you do not like.

alsoWithUs.title: A creator community
alsoWithUs.text: Groups, events and meet-ups where you meet other creators.

trips.title: Create together, somewhere new.
trips.text: We organise sponsored trips where creators come together to create content, collaborate with each other and work on brand projects arranged for the trip. We share the details in a personal meeting.
bullets: Brand projects arranged for the trip

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Tell us who you are and what you make.

steps.title: We review
steps.text: We look at your content, your audience and how well you fit with brands we work with.

steps.title: We talk
steps.text: We discuss your goals and what support you want.

steps.title: We start
steps.text: Terms are written down and agreed before any work begins. Then we plan your first deals and content.

faqs.a: Anyone. We review every application and choose creators ourselves.

faqs.q: How do the commercial terms work?
faqs.a: Terms are agreed one to one in a personal meeting and written down before work starts.

faqs.q: Do I have to take every brand you bring?
faqs.a: No. You are free to accept or decline any brand. There is no pressure either way.
Yes. You keep ownership of your content.
We organise sponsored trips where creators come together to create content and collaborate. We explain how they work in a personal meeting.
Groups, events and meet-ups where creators meet each other.

faqs.q: Does it cost anything to apply?

faqs.a: We can help with it. What that means for you is discussed in a personal meeting.

faqs.q: Can you help me find people for my videos?
faqs.a: Yes. If your content needs a supporting cast, we help you find people for the side roles.

form.consentText: I agree that Noise Culture may store and use these details to review my application and contact me.
form.successMessage: Thanks. We have received your application and will be in touch.
